title: Science Outreach Programme, University of Hyderabad
location: School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad
teaser: Science outreach programme at the School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad, on 8 November 2019, featuring a science quiz, elocution competition, and lectures by Prof. Sanjay Subodh and Dr. Shivaji.
homepageMatter: A science outreach programme at the School of Life Sciences, University of Hyderabad, on 8 November 2019, in collaboration with UoH. Students (Class VIII–XII) participated in a science quiz and elocution competition, followed by lectures on medieval buildings and polar life forms.
